name: smoothdata_sgolay
comment: Sig: smoothdata(x, 'sgolay', window). Savitzky-Golay smoothing (degree 2) via the projection matrix B = A*(A'A)^-1*A' (interior = centre row, edges = boundary rows) — matches MATLAB sgolayfilt/smoothdata exactly for an explicit ODD window. Fixes bugs/stats/smoothdata-methods (sgolay stub threw). NB the AUTO default window is NOT parity-tested: MATLAB's default is a data-dependent heuristic (window varied 2..6 for the same N=12 depending on the data) that numkit's shared k-default only approximates; the explicit-window form (validated here) is exact. lowess/loess still throw (separate local-regression work). Verified vs MATLAB R2025b: w=5 -> [1.1143 3.7429 5.0857 4.4 ...], w=7 -> [1.3333 ... 6.4762].
